g.desc: Inventory: title, two input distributions I1 and I2 above two state nodes x1 and x2; downward arrows connect inputs to nodes and nodes to action probabilities; recurrent curved links connect the two state nodes. Basis: approximate left-right symmetry about the center between x1 and x2, with distinct colors for each side.

Inventory: heatmap of Hopfield energy on x1-x2 axes, viridis-like color field, white state samples in two attractor clouds, purple trajectory curve, green guide lines, and a vertical colorbar. Basis: square energy domain with orthogonal axes and paired attractor regions near upper-left and lower-right.

Inventory: time-series plot of neural network states x1 and x2 with blue/orange jagged traces, axes, labels, legend, and right-side marginal activity densities. Basis: horizontal temporal axis with paired bimodal state levels and a separate aligned vertical density strip sharing the same y-scale.
